changelog: Reduces Personalized TV wall-clock/grid handoff latency from Jellyfin Web's 10-second periodic progress cadence to a 1.5-second post-PlaybackStart readiness buffer. Concrete scheduled VOD still opens at 00:00 first; once the exact client VOD PlaybackStart is accepted, Virtual TV waits 1.5 seconds, recalculates the current Guide offset, and sends one seek. If the client rebuilds/restarts the VOD before that command, the 1.5-second window restarts from the newest PlaybackStart so a stale timer cannot seek too early. Next Unwatched, Random Unwatched and the already-working Resume path are unchanged. Loading remains 1.5 seconds, Standard TV and the UI remain unchanged.
